item.title: Jimmy Barnes, ICEHOUSE and More Pay Tribute to Cold Chisel Saxophonist Andy Bickers
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of music and trends. Today, we're sad to report on the passing of a legendary saxophonist, Andy Bickers. The 56-year-old New Zealand-born musician was a defining element of Cold Chisel's live sound for over three decades."
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "According to a statement posted by Cold Chisel on social media, Andy lost his battle with cancer. The band remembered him as 'our brother: an incredible musician and a great person to be out on the road or out on the town with.' His contributions to songs like 'Rising Sun', 'Saturday Night', and 'My Baby' will be deeply missed."
[Clip of Cold Chisel's music plays briefly]
Host: "Frontman Jimmy Barnes, who gave Andy his entry point into Australian rock, paid tribute to his friend and colleague. He remembered Andy as 'a great player, funny, intelligent, and most importantly, a good man.' ICEHOUSE's Iva Davies also shared his condolences, reflecting on their recent performance together."
[Clip of ICEHOUSE's music plays briefly]
Host: "Andy's remarkable career spanned collaborations with Midnight Oil, Silverchair, the Eagles, and many more. His talent and dedication earned him a reputation as one of Australia's most reliable session and touring musicians."
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: "Midnight Oil, Richard Clapton, and many others in the music community have paid tribute to Andy, remembering his incredible talent and his impact on the industry. Our thoughts are with his family, including his wife Lisa and son Rudy, during this difficult time."
[Music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: "That's all for today. We'll miss Andy Bickers' incredible sax playing, but his legacy will live on through the music he created. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode."
[Music fades out completely]
